task.title: Improve WebAR motion responsiveness and heading accuracy across mobile sensor implementations. [tdd:required]
task.definition_of_done: Valid fallback acceleration detects walking without duplicate rapid steps; faster cadence updates distance promptly; heading follows the shortest turn across 0°/360° without a visible 300 ms lag.

checks.description: Valid fallback acceleration detects walking without duplicate rapid steps; faster cadence updates distance promptly; heading follows the shortest turn across 0°/360° without a visible 300 ms lag.
Null linear acceleration falls back to gravity-inclusive motion
Distinct steps at 320 ms cadence are detected once per peak
Heading crosses 0/360 via the shortest turn without a 300 ms CSS lag

browser_validation.description: Valid fallback acceleration detects walking without duplicate rapid steps; faster cadence updates distance promptly; heading follows the shortest turn across 0°/360° without a visible 300 ms lag.

followups: Verify cadence thresholds and step-length tuning with a physical-phone walk test after deployment.
